notes.title: New Patch - 1.7
notes.content:
In addition to the latest DLC, a new patch has been released! 

[list]
[*] An audio latency adjustment screen has been added to the Boom Shack
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Changes to Boom Shack menu to accommodate newly-released DLC
[*] An unlockable Golden Ziggs costume has been added for all players
[/list]

notes.title: Trading Cards Are Here!
notes.content:
Hextech Mayhem Steam Trading Cards have landed! 

If you don't already know, Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and trade-able Steam community items. 

Hextech Mayhem's Community Items Include: 


[list]
[*] Animated Avatars
[*] Avatar Frames
[*] Mini-Profile Backgrounds
[*] Profile Backgrounds
[*] Animated Stickers
[*] Emoticons
[/list]

(Preview:[url=] https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1651960[/url])

Also! No need to worry, Trading Cards will be given to players retroactively for time already played.

What are you still doing on this post? What are you waiting for? Get playing! It is time to collect and trade!

notes.title: Patch v1.1 - Update
notes.content: We've come to the conclusion that Patch v1.1 has created some issue with gameplay. We are actively working to correct this. For now, we are rolling back this patch and will release a proper one next week. Thank you for your continued patience!
